latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — guidance for working with content management systems:

- Covers workflows for building and modifying themes, plugins, modules, admin panels, media uploads, content models, editors, and static export in major CMS platforms.
- Details how to identify key CMS seams and approach common platform constraints.
- Provides actionable rules and best practices for themes/templates, plugins/extensions, admin/editor UX, media handling, content models, migrations, and markdown/static export workflows.
- Includes advice for distinguishing CMS roles and making safe, minimal changes.
- Reference section points to mappings for common CMS platforms.
